info.name: Azure Repos Git Commits Pull Requests API

params.name: repositoryId
params.description: The ID or name of the repository

params.name: searchCriteria.status
params.description: Filter by pull request status. Defaults to active if unset.

params.name: searchCriteria.creatorId
params.description: Filter by the identity ID of the pull request creator

params.name: searchCriteria.reviewerId
params.description: Filter by the identity ID of a reviewer

params.name: searchCriteria.sourceRefName
params.description: Filter by source branch name (e.g., refs/heads/feature)

params.name: searchCriteria.targetRefName
params.description: Filter by target branch name (e.g., refs/heads/main)

params.name: searchCriteria.repositoryId
params.description: Filter by target repository ID

params.name: searchCriteria.sourceRepositoryId
params.description: Filter by source repository ID

params.name: searchCriteria.includeLinks
params.description: Whether to include the _links field on shallow references

params.name: searchCriteria.minTime
params.description: Filter pull requests created or closed after this date based on queryTimeRangeType

params.name: searchCriteria.maxTime
params.description: Filter pull requests created or closed before this date based on queryTimeRangeType

params.name: searchCriteria.queryTimeRangeType
params.description: The type of time range for minTime and maxTime. Defaults to created if unset.

params.name: $top
params.description: Number of pull requests to retrieve

params.name: $skip
params.description: Number of pull requests to skip

items.docs: Retrieve all pull requests matching specified criteria for a repository. Supports filtering by status, creator, reviewer, source branch, target branch, and time range. The description field is truncated to 400 characters in the result.

info.name: Azure Repos Create a pull request

params.name: repositoryId
params.description: The ID or name of the repository

items.docs: Create a new pull request in the specified repository. Requires source and target branch references, a title, and optionally a description, reviewers, and work item references.

info.name: Azure Repos Get a pull request

params.name: repositoryId
params.description: The ID or name of the repository

params.name: pullRequestId
params.description: ID of the pull request

items.docs: Retrieve a specific pull request by its ID. Returns full pull request details including status, reviewers, merge status, source and target branches, and linked work items.

info.name: Azure Repos Update a pull request

params.name: repositoryId
params.description: The ID or name of the repository

params.name: pullRequestId
params.description: ID of the pull request

items.docs: Update properties of an existing pull request such as title, description, status (to abandon or reactivate), auto-complete settings, and completion options including merge strategy.

info.name: Azure Repos List pull request commits

params.name: repositoryId
params.description: The ID or name of the repository

params.name: pullRequestId
params.description: ID of the pull request

items.docs: Retrieve the list of commits associated with a pull request. Returns commits from the source branch that are not yet in the target branch.
